name: Candlelight: Coldplay vs. Imagine Dragons
description: Experience the stadium-sized hits of two of the world's biggest bands in a magical new light, performed live in an intimate, candlelit setting.
longDescription:
Candlelight: Coldplay vs. Imagine Dragons presents an evening of musical arrangements from two globally recognized rock bands. This event is part of the Candlelight Concerts series, known for reinterpreting popular music and classical compositions in unique settings. The performance will feature instrumental renditions of well-known songs from Coldplay, a British band formed in 1996, and Imagine Dragons, an American band established in 2008.

Attendees will experience a concert atmosphere illuminated by candlelight, providing a distinct backdrop for the musical program. The performance duration is typically around 60-75 minutes. The specific location for this event in Porto is yet to be announced, but Candlelight concerts often take place in venues that offer an intimate or historically significant ambiance. The event is designed for a general audience interested in live music.

Tickets for this event are priced variably and can be purchased online. The exact venue details, including accessibility information and public transport links, will be confirmed closer to the event date of 2026-09-26.
